careMatch.title: CareMatch — find the right specialist
careMatch.intro: Tell us what's bothering you in your own words, or pick the closest option below.
careMatch.inputPlaceholder: e.g. "headache and fever since 2 days" or "hair fall"
careMatch.noMatch: We couldn't match that to a specialty. A General Physician is the best first step — they can examine you and refer you if needed.
careMatch.emergency: Severe chest pain, trouble breathing, heavy bleeding or fainting? Call your local emergency number right away — don't wait for an online consult.

services.sectionSubtitle: Everything you need to look after your health — from a quick consult to long-term care — in one place.
services.helpCardText: Answer one quick question and CareMatch will point you to the right specialist.

consultation.title: Online Doctor Consultation
consultation.subtitle: for your health issues
consultation.overview: Speak to a verified doctor from home over video, audio or chat. No travel, no waiting room — just a focused conversation with a specialist who has your history in front of them. Most patients find a doctor and are in a consultation the same day.

features.title: Video, audio or chat
features.desc: Pick the mode that suits you. Video for a face-to-face exam, audio on a weak connection, chat when you need privacy.

features.title: Instant digital prescriptions
features.desc: Your doctor writes your prescription during the consult. Download it as a PDF straight away and show it at any pharmacy.

features.title: Follow-up care
features.desc: Book a follow-up with the same doctor in a couple of taps. Your past notes and prescriptions are already there.

features.title: Verified specialists
features.desc: Every doctor's registration and credentials are reviewed by our team before they can take appointments.

steps.title: Search
steps.desc: Type a symptom, specialty or doctor name — or let CareMatch suggest one.

steps.title: Book a slot
steps.desc: See the fee and open slots up front, then pay securely.

steps.title: Consult
steps.desc: Join from your phone or laptop at your slot time.

steps.title: Get your prescription
steps.desc: Download it instantly; it's saved in your Health Vault too.

idealFor: Fever, cold, cough and everyday illness
Skin, hair and allergy concerns
Stress, anxiety and sleep problems
Second opinions and report reviews
Repeat prescriptions for ongoing conditions

faqs.q: Is an online consultation as good as an in-person visit?
faqs.a: For most common, non-emergency problems, yes. If your doctor feels you need a physical exam or tests, they'll tell you during the consult.

faqs.q: Is my prescription valid at a pharmacy?
faqs.a: Yes. Prescriptions are issued by registered doctors and include their details and signature.

faqs.q: What if I need to talk to the doctor again?
faqs.a: Book a follow-up from your appointments page. The doctor will see your earlier notes and prescription.

labTest.title: Lab Test
labTest.subtitle: in the comfort of your home
labTest.overview: Get blood and routine tests done without stepping out. A trained professional collects your sample at home, your report arrives digitally, and a doctor can walk you through what the numbers actually mean.

features.title: Home sample collection
features.desc: Choose a time slot and a trained phlebotomist visits your home with sealed, single-use kits.

features.title: Digital reports
features.desc: Reports are delivered online and stored in your Health Vault, so you never lose a paper copy again.

features.title: Expert analysis
features.desc: Share your report with a doctor in a consult and get a clear explanation and next steps.

features.title: Track over time
features.desc: Keep every report in one place and compare results across months.

steps.title: Choose your test
steps.desc: Pick a test yourself or get one recommended by your doctor.

steps.title: Sample at home
steps.desc: A professional collects your sample at the time you chose.

steps.title: Report online
steps.desc: Your digital report is ready to view and download.

steps.title: Review with a doctor
steps.desc: Book a consult to understand your results.

idealFor: Routine annual health checks
Monitoring diabetes, thyroid or cholesterol
Elderly family members who find travel difficult
Tests your doctor has asked for after a consult

faqs.q: Do I need a prescription for a lab test?
faqs.a: Not for routine tests. For specialised tests, a doctor's recommendation helps make sure you take the right one.
In your Health Vault, alongside your prescriptions and other records.

faqs.q: Can a doctor explain my report?
faqs.a: Yes — book a consult and share the report. The doctor will explain the results and suggest next steps.

weightManagement.title: Weight Management
weightManagement.subtitle: personalized care for you
weightManagement.overview: Lasting weight change comes from a plan built around you, not a generic diet chart. Work with nutritionists and doctors who look at your health, lifestyle and goals, then track your progress week by week.

features.title: Custom plans
features.desc: Your nutritionist builds a diet plan around your routine, food preferences and medical history. It appears right in your dashboard.

features.title: Monitoring tools
features.desc: Log weight, BMI, water, sleep and activity. Charts show your trend so you can spot changes early and discuss them at your follow-up.

features.title: Multi-specialty care
features.desc: Bring in a general physician, gynecologist or psychiatrist when weight is linked to thyroid, PCOS, stress or sleep.

features.title: Goals and streaks
features.desc: Set realistic weekly goals and keep momentum with streaks and progress milestones.

steps.title: Consult a nutritionist
steps.desc: Share your goals, routine and any health conditions.

steps.title: Get your plan
steps.desc: Receive a personalised diet plan in your dashboard.

steps.title: Track daily
steps.desc: Log weight, meals, water and activity in a few seconds.

steps.title: Review and adjust
steps.desc: Follow up regularly to fine-tune your plan.

idealFor: Healthy, sustainable weight loss or gain
Weight linked to PCOS, thyroid or diabetes
Post-pregnancy weight goals
Anyone who's tried generic diets without results

faqs.q: Will I get a fixed diet chart?
faqs.a: No. Your plan is written for you and updated as your progress and needs change.

faqs.q: How do I track my progress?
faqs.a: Use the weight, water, sleep and activity trackers in your patient dashboard, and review the trends with your nutritionist at each follow-up.

faqs.q: What if my weight is linked to a medical condition?
faqs.a: Your nutritionist can recommend a specialist, so diet and treatment work together.

healthcarePlans.title: Healthcare Plans
healthcarePlans.subtitle: for holistic care
healthcarePlans.overview: Healthcare Plans turn one-off visits into continuous care. With a monthly package you and your family get regular consultations, preventive check-ins and ongoing monitoring — so small problems are caught before they become big ones.

features.title: Monthly packages
features.desc: A predictable monthly plan that covers regular consultations, so cost never stops you from asking a doctor.

features.title: Preventive care
features.desc: Scheduled check-ins and screening reminders based on your age, history and risk factors.

features.title: Health monitoring
features.desc: Your vitals, medications and wellness logs in one place, reviewed by your doctor over time.

features.title: One health record
features.desc: Prescriptions, reports and notes stay together in your Health Vault, ready for every consult.

steps.title: Create your account
steps.desc: Sign up and complete your health profile.

steps.title: Choose a plan
steps.desc: Pick the package that fits you or your family.

steps.title: Stay on track
steps.desc: Get reminders for check-ins, medicines and screenings.

steps.title: Consult anytime
steps.desc: Reach a doctor whenever something comes up.

idealFor: Families who want one place for everyone's health
People managing long-term conditions
Adults focused on prevention and annual check-ups
Caregivers looking after elderly parents

faqs.a: Regular check-ins with a doctor, reminders for age-appropriate screenings, and monitoring of your vitals and medications.
Plans are designed for individuals and families. Get in touch with our team for family options.

faqs.q: Do I still keep my records if I stop?
faqs.a: Yes. Your Health Vault and history stay with your account.

selfDiagnostic.title: Self Diagnostic Tools
selfDiagnostic.subtitle: for self assessment
selfDiagnostic.overview: Understand your body better between consultations. Check your symptoms to find the right specialist, keep an eye on your vitals, and track wellness habits — all free, all in your dashboard. These tools guide you; they don't replace a doctor's diagnosis.

features.title: Symptom checker
features.desc: Describe how you feel in plain words and CareMatch suggests which specialist to see.

features.title: Health assessments
features.desc: Record blood pressure, sugar, pulse, SpO2 and temperature, and see your history at a glance.

features.title: Wellness tracking
features.desc: Log mood, sleep, water and activity daily, and watch your habits improve over time.

features.title: Health reports
features.desc: See your logs summarised into a clear health report you can go through with your doctor.

steps.title: Check symptoms
steps.desc: Tell CareMatch what's bothering you.

steps.title: Log your vitals
steps.desc: Add readings in seconds from your dashboard.

steps.title: Spot patterns
steps.desc: Charts show how your health trends over time.

steps.title: Consult when needed
steps.desc: Bring your readings to a consult with a verified doctor.

idealFor: Deciding which specialist to see
Tracking blood pressure or sugar at home
Building healthier sleep, water and activity habits
Preparing for a consultation with real data

faqs.q: Is the symptom checker a diagnosis?
faqs.a: No. It points you to the right kind of doctor. Only a doctor can diagnose you.
Yes. They're available to every patient with a PhoenixCare account.

faqs.q: How do these tools help my consultation?
faqs.a: Walking in with real readings and trends — instead of guesses — helps your doctor understand what's happening faster.

why.title: Care that rises with you
why.subtitle: PhoenixCare isn't just a video call with a doctor. It's a complete, connected health companion — before, during and long after your consultation.
why.promiseText: Like the phoenix, we believe everyone deserves the chance to rise stronger. That means doctors you can trust, prices you can see, and records you control.

reasons.title: Verified doctors only
reasons.desc: Every doctor's medical registration, qualifications and experience are checked by our team before they can see a single patient.

reasons.title: Consult your way
reasons.desc: Choose video, audio or chat — whatever suits your comfort, connection and privacy. Join from your phone or laptop.

reasons.title: Instant digital prescriptions
reasons.desc: Get a clear, signed PDF prescription the moment your consult ends — easy to read and accepted at pharmacies.

reasons.title: Your Health Vault
reasons.desc: Prescriptions, lab reports and records live in one secure place, so every doctor you see has the full picture.

reasons.title: Transparent fees
reasons.desc: See each doctor's consultation fee before you book. Pay securely online, with no surprise charges.

reasons.title: Care beyond the visit
reasons.desc: Track vitals, mood, sleep, water and medications, follow diet plans from your doctor, and get reminders that keep you on track.

reasons.title: Plain-language search
reasons.desc: No medical jargon needed. Search "skin rash" or "chest pain" and we'll show you the right specialist.

reasons.title: In your language
reasons.desc: Use PhoenixCare in English, Hindi or Spanish, so nothing about your health gets lost in translation.
